ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: After ignoring the curved arrows in the figure, on the left there is an R group connected to the central carbon; above the central carbon is labeled H, on the right it is connected to OH, and below it is connected to the N atom of a nitrogen-containing five-membered saturated ring. This five-membered ring consists of N and four methylene carbons, forming a pyrrolidine-like ring. Reasoning: According to the method draft, represent the left R group as the wildcard atom *, which is connected to the central carbon. The central carbon is also connected to the hydroxyl O and the ring nitrogen, and the H in the figure is treated as an implicit hydrogen of the central carbon in SMILES. The nitrogen-containing five-membered saturated ring is encoded starting from N as N1CCCC1. Attach both the hydroxyl branch and this ring to the central carbon connected to *, obtaining SMILES: *C(O)N1CCCC1.

method.method_draft: First transcribe only the atom-bond skeleton from the image. Treat the left R group as a wildcard atom attached to the central carbon. The central carbon is also bonded to OH and to the ring nitrogen, with its H implicit in SMILES. Then encode the nitrogen-containing five-membered saturated ring by starting at N with ring index 1 and proceeding through four methylene carbons back to N: `N1CCCC1`. Attach this ring and the hydroxyl branch to the central carbon connected to `*`, yielding `*C(O)N1CCCC1`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中忽略弯箭头后，左侧有一个 R 基团连到中心碳；中心碳上方标有 H，右侧连有 OH，下面连到一个含氮五元饱和环的 N 原子。该五元环由 N 和四个亚甲基碳组成，形成吡咯烷样环。推理：按方法草案，将左侧 R 基团表示为通配原子 *，它与中心碳相连。中心碳还连接羟基 O 和环氮，图中的 H 在 SMILES 中作为中心碳的隐式氢处理。含氮五元饱和环从 N 开始编码为 N1CCCC1。把羟基支链和该环都接到与 * 相连的中心碳上，得到 SMILES：*C(O)N1CCCC1。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-to-SMILES route: identify the connectivity in the displayed skeletal structure after ignoring curved arrows, replace the generic R substituent with the SMILES wildcard atom, and encode the attached pyrrolidine ring from nitrogen.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the central tetrahedral carbon bearing H upward, OH to the right, a generic R group to the left, and an N atom downward. Read the N as part of a saturated five-membered ring with four carbon atoms, i.e., pyrrolidine. Ignore the curved reaction arrows and lone-pair/transition-state markings as instructed.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression and that arrows in the transition-state drawing should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: a generic/unknown substituent R can be represented by wildcard `*`; hydrogens on normal valence atoms are usually implicit; a hydroxyl substituent attached through oxygen is written `(O)`; a saturated N-containing five-membered ring can be encoded as `N1CCCC1`. Combine the branches around the central carbon to give `*C(O)N1CCCC1`.
